Method of Attack: Leaking sensitive information such as AWS access credentials, email credentials, and database credentials
Hard-coded API keys and access tokens in the codebase
Publishing plaintext credentials to public repositories
Attack Vector: Inclusion of sensitive files in release artifacts
Failure to remove secrets from codebase before publishing
Indicators of Compromise: config.py file containing AWS access credentials
prod.py file with email and database credentials
meutils package containing internal access keys
cm.conf file listing multiple employee access keys
